title.narrative: Activity under preparation PROCULTURA II - PALOP-TL - Africa-Europe Partnership for Culture

description.narrative: The objective of the Action is to enhance the employability within the cultural and creative sectors (CCS) by strengthening skills, cooperation and mobility in the PALOP-TL countries[1]. The Action is the follow up of the PALOP-TL PROCULTURA project, which started in 2019 and ends in June 2025. The Action will consolidate the results achieved under the previous project, with a transversal focus to the cultural sub-sectors, a stronger focus on the emerging local cultural initiatives, a greater emphasis on the PALOP-TL-Europe partnership, and a new component to strengthen the public authorities in charge of the cultural and creative sector.The Action will focus on three specific objectives:i) Improve professional skills and competences of the cultural and creative sectors to enhance entrepreneurial development, particularly of women, youth and persons with disabilities.ii) Increase dissemination and commercialisation of PALOP-TL cultural and creative products and services. iii) Strengthen the capacities of the public sector to develop/implement policies, legal frameworks, and measures in favor of the cultural and creative sectors.Emphasis will be placed on reinforcing abilities to establish and sustain initiatives, support public institutions and civil society organizations, and provide better access to markets, with a focus on youth and women in the PALOP-TL region.The lead entity in charge of this action is the EU Delegation to Mozambique.The entity in charge of the contract management is the EU Delegation to Mozambique.[1] Angola, Cape Verde, Guinea-Bissau, Mozambique, São Tomé and Príncipe, and Timor Leste.
